name: QA Bug Report Tool
one_liner: Converts rough QA notes into structured Markdown and JSON bug reports.
evidence_focus: Bug writing, repro quality, severity/priority thinking, pytest-backed validation, Markdown export.
known_limitations: Practice QA CLI, not a production bug tracker or replacement for human triage.

name: Nyx Test Planner
one_liner: Turns early Nyx gameplay ideas into human-reviewed test scenarios, risk notes, status tracking, and Markdown test-plan exports.
evidence_focus: QA planning judgment, risk/status tracking, expected results, Markdown export, and planned PIE validation notes.
known_limitations: Planning aid only; manual PIE/prototype validation remains pending until actually run.

name: Art Telemetry QA
project_category: Art QA / Technical QA Python CLI
one_liner: Parses mock Unreal-style telemetry into Art QA risk summaries, owner-routing notes, regression notes, and Jira-ready reports.
evidence_focus: Mock Unreal-style telemetry, Art QA evidence, risk summaries, owner routing, and Jira-ready reports.
known_limitations: Human-reviewed reports do not replace Tech Art, Performance, Engineering, or human QA judgment.

name: Community Pulse
one_liner: Turns mock player/playtest feedback into structured theme summaries, risk notes, and human-reviewed QA follow-up reports.
evidence_focus: Mock feedback grouping, repeated themes, readiness summary, risk notes, and Markdown export.
known_limitations: Draft aid for human review, not a live social listening platform or automated community decision-maker.

name: External QA Handoff Manager
one_liner: Turns feature goals into outsource-ready test packets with scenario coverage, bug-quality standards, evidence requirements, intake review, and Markdown handoff exports.
evidence_focus: External QA coordination, evidence requirements, intake checklist, scenario coverage, and Markdown export.
known_limitations: Static human-reviewed MVP with hard-coded sample data and no live vendor/Jira integration.
